basic_details.job_title: GHB Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Lower Division Clerk Group, LDC Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Goa Housing Board, Porvorim, has invited applications for two posts: one Lower Division Clerk (Group “C”, Level-2) and one Multi Tasking Staff (Group “C”, Level-1). Both vacancies are for the EWS category. Applications in the prescribed format go to the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Building 'A', 2nd Floor, New Market Complex, Porvorim, Bardez, Goa - 403521, and must reach by 26 November 2026, as late applications will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: GHB Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

rows.details: Lower Division Clerk Group “C”; Multi Tasking Staff Group “C”
Level-2 (Lower Division Clerk); Level-1 (Multi Tasking Staff)
Higher Secondary / AICTE-approved Diploma (LDC); SSC / ITI course (MTS); knowledge of Konkani for both
Application in prescribed format, submitted to the Managing Director
26/11/2026 (applications received after the due date are rejected)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Submit the application in the prescribed format to: The Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Building 'A', 2nd Floor, New Market Complex, Porvorim, Bardez, Goa - 403521. The notice does not state the postal mode. The application format is available on the Goa Housing Board website, www.ghb.goa.gov.in , and on the Government portal. The format is also printed on pages 3 to 6 of the notice. All entries must be in block letters, in the candidate's own handwriting. Items must not be added, deleted or carried to another page. The form asks for the year, the serial number and name of the post applied for, full name, postal and residential addresses (with proof), telephone numbers, date and place of birth, age on the closing date, nationality, category, languages known, education, training, work experience and other relevant information. A passport-size photograph is pasted on the form, with the signature put half on the photograph and half on the form. The form also asks whether the candidate has state or national level participation in sports, NSS, NCC or extra-curricular activities (certificates to be attached if yes), and about any conviction, major penalty or pending prosecution or disciplinary action. The form ends with a declaration that false or incorrect information can lead to the candidature being cancelled or rejected even after selection. Persons already in Government service must send the application through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice prints only the pay levels, not the rupee amounts. Essential: Higher Secondary School Certificate, or an All India Council for Technical Education approved Diploma awarded by a recognized State Board of Technical Education, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized Institution. Essential: knowledge of computer applications / operations with typing speed of 30 words per minute in English. Essential: knowledge of Konkani. Desirable: knowledge of Marathi. Essential: passed the Secondary School Certificate Examination from a recognized Board/Institution, OR passed a course conducted by an Industrial Training Institute, or an equivalent qualification, in the relevant trade, from a recognized Institution. Essential: knowledge of Konkani. Desirable: knowledge of Marathi. For both posts the age must not exceed 45 years. The limit is relaxable for Government servants and for candidates belonging to reserved categories, in accordance with instructions or orders issued by the Government. The notice does not print a minimum age. The cut-off date for educational qualifications, age limit and experience is the last date of application. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested documents are to be sent along with the application, such as: Birth Certificate Certificates of Qualification 15 years Residence Certificate in the State of Goa Employment Card Aadhaar Card Experience Certificate EWS Certificate The notice lists these with "etc.", so other documents may also be needed. The form also has a section to list the details of enclosures.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GHB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Lower Division Clerk and 1 Multi Tasking Staff, both for the EWS category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Goa Housing Board posts?
faq.answer: Applications are invited latest by 26/11/2026. Applications received after the due date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: It goes to the Managing Director, Goa Housing Board, Building 'A', 2nd Floor, New Market Complex, Porvorim, Bardez, Goa - 403521.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Lower Division Clerk?
faq.answer: Higher Secondary School Certificate, or an AICTE-approved Diploma from a recognized State Board of Technical Education, or an equivalent qualification. Computer knowledge with 30 words per minute English typing and knowledge of Konkani are also essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Multi Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: Passed the Secondary School Certificate Examination, or an Industrial Training Institute course (or equivalent) in the relevant trade, from a recognized Institution. Knowledge of Konkani is also essential.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age must not exceed 45 years, counted as on the last date of application. It is relaxable for Government servants and reserved categories as per Government orders.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The Lower Division Clerk post carries Level-2 pay and the Multi Tasking Staff post carries Level-1 pay. The notice does not print the amounts.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I get the application form?
faq.answer: The format is available on the Goa Housing Board website, www.ghb.goa.gov.in, and on the Government portal. It is also printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of the Birth Certificate, Certificates of Qualification, 15 years Residence Certificate in the State of Goa, Employment Card, Aadhaar Card, Experience Certificate and EWS Certificate, etc.

faq.question: Q10. Can a Government servant apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but persons already in Government service must send the application through proper channel.
